title: Virginia International Raceway

services.name: Track Rentals
services.desc: VIRginia International Raceway is available for track rentals seven days a week, 50 weeks out of the year in any number of course configurations. Track renters include car clubs, driving and riding schools, automotive original equipment manufacturers, tire manufacturers, race teams, advertising agencies and media. All track renters must follow the rules and policies set forth in Exhibit A of their contract. Ask us about booking your next team-building activity or corporate retreat for some real thrills. services.name: VIR Kart Track
services.desc: The VIR Kart Track is a state-of-the-art 5/8 mile, 24-foot-wide paved circuit right in the heart of Southern Virginia. Our karts run ungoverned Honda GX 270cc motors capable of speeds in excess of 50 mph, the fastest speeds you’ll find for go-karts anywhere in the region! Feed your need for speed and test your racing skills right here at VIRginia International Raceway. Reservations required. Book your reservation at the Kart Track to secure your time.
